notes.title: New Demo Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Here's a [b]small update[/b] addressing some of the frustrations you mentioned in the previous build:


[list]
[*][b]Falling down is now harder[/b]
[*][b]Getting up is faster[/b]
[*][b]Rebalanced damage[/b], more damage to vital organs, less to non vital,
[*][b]Improved stabbing with polearms[/b], they don't fly away from your hands now
[*][b]Slightly rebalanced certain weapons[/b], nerfed warstaff's damage against armor (sorry, it was way too overpowered)[/list]


____________________________________________________________
[b]About Fatal Crashes:[/b]
We’re aware of the fatal crashes, especially during the Baron fight. These issues stem from a third-party Unreal Engine plugin we’ve been using for some of the blood and gore effects.
While we initially tried to debug it, we’ve hit its limitations. That’s why we’re now developing our own in-house solution, which will be ready for the Early Access release — offering both improved stability and next-level wounds for you to inflict on poor Willie.
_____________________________________________________________

Thanks again for the tremendous support, we still can’t believe how big Half Sword has gotten, and it’s not even out yet!

Half Sword Games & Game Seer

notes.title: Super-realistic medieval sim Half Sword explodes on Steam after giant new update
notes.content:
Half Sword is to medieval games what Hell Let Loose is to the WW2 FPS - while Chivalry, Kingdom Come Deliverance 2, and Mount and Blade have excellent, larger-scale combat, in Half Sword, the difference between life and death is represented by a single slash. Get a clean hit on your opponent, or take a proper blow yourself, and it's light out; combined with the meticulously designed blood and body physics, that system makes Half Sword one of the most eagerly awaited sword-and-shield brawlers on PC. We're still waiting on the full launch, but after a transformative update, the stalwart Half Sword demo is suddenly bigger on Steam than ever before.

Read the rest of the story...

RELATED LINKS:
Half Sword playtest rebalances its medieval weapons, quite literally
Chivalry meets QWOP in silly medieval combat sim with free Steam demo

notes.title: End of Playtests & Demo Major Update
notes.content:
Hello!
[b]Let’s be honest with you:[/b] having two separate test versions on Steam ended up being more confusing than helpful for most players. That’s why [b]we’ve decided to shut down the Playtest and merge its content with the Abyss into a single, unified Demo[/b].

In addition to that : 
•    Added a [b]new Gauntlet Mode[/b], where you earn points to unlock new Ranks. [b]Dying in that mode sends you to the Abyss[/b]. Dying in the Abyss deletes your current character and you lose all your progress in Gauntlet Mode. 
•    In [b]Free Mode you can play all the Ranks[/b] (just like in Playtest) except the final one, the new Barron tier. 
•    [b]Abyss has been updated[/b] with new physics, combat, armors and weapons. We are aware of performance issues and we're already working on them as we speak.
•    You can also access Abyss from the main menu by killing your character in main menu.

Now, yesterday, we decided to shadow drop an early version of this update as an April 1st joke, without explanation or patch notes. We genuinely thought it would be a fun surprise and something you'd enjoy.

Clearly, some of you didn’t see it that way.[b] If we annoyed or frustrated you, we’re genuinely sorry.[/b]

Making a game is tough, bugs happen, things break, and sometimes we misjudge how something will land. That said, part of this update was also a way for us to test how players respond to different experiences: the intensity and challenge of Gauntlet, the chill, rewarding flow of Free Mode, and the strange, unsettling charm of Abyss, which has always been part of our DNA.

[b]We’re still fully committed to delivering a compelling, satisfying game for everyone, and your feedback always helps us get there.[/b]

[b]Half Sword is an ongoing experiment, and you're a vital part of it.[/b] We're incredibly grateful for your presence, your playtesting, and your support. We'll keep working hard to earn your trust, your time, and your attention, every step of the way.

Half Sword Games & Game Seer

For further details and more join our [url=https://discord.gg/halfsword]Discord community[/url]!

notes.title: Blood update is here!
notes.content:
Hello Half Sworders,

Soon has finally come! And with it we bring you the first major update for the Half Sword Playtest!

[previewyoutube=xpQ0jORODEA;full][/previewyoutube]

This update has more small and big changes than we can remember but here is a rough list:

[h2]COMBAT SYSTEM[/h2]

[list]
[*] Added Kicking! (Space Bar)
[*] Tweaked Parrying! Now you have more control over it
[*] Nerfed blunt damage and boosted armor defense against it
[*] Improved grip switching! Now you will not do One Punch Man punch every time you grab your weapon... not every time...
[/list]

[h2]GAME[/h2]

[list]
[*] Added practice dummy! Perfect for sharpening your skills before you face human opponents (when ingame, hold the G key to skip this part).
[*] Tweaked physics, as we always do.
[/list]

[h2]SOUND[/h2]

[list]
[*] Added new juicy slashing and crushing sounds!
[/list]

and as the pinnacle of this update...

[h2]BLOOD AND GORE[/h2]

[list]
[*] Added new blood particles (WIP)
[*] Added new blood effects including blood running down from the wounds
[*] Blood pooling is back!
[*] Armor and clothing damage!
[*] Bruises!
[*] Internal organs!
[*] And finally.. first time since 2013 (might be untrue)... DYNAMIC SLICING!!!
[/list]

Yes Yes! You can split em wide open wherever you slice ! And As many times as you want! 
[b]Please note: this is very WIP!!!![/b]

This system is still very much work in progress and is not stable yet. You WILL encounter lots of bugs with it.. duplicated bodies, slices not appearing, etc...
We are actively working on this system to bring the best slicing since Metal Gear Rising to our game and we promise that eventually, it will work properly (:

We will be adding gore and blood settings soon - now you are free to enjoy a default brutality (:

We are aware of numerous bugs and issues you may experience in this update and we will be releasing fixes for them constantly in nearest future...
If you encounter any... abnormalities... please report them on our official Discord - you can find the link in-game.

Thanks for your continued support!

LOWER THE GATES!

notes.title: Playtest Update #1
notes.content:
Hey Half Sworders,

We’re immensely grateful for your participation in our playtests! Your efforts and dedication have been invaluable in helping us improve our game. [b]We're excited to present our first playtest update![/b] 

New Features and Improvements:
[list]
[*][b]DirectX 11 and 12 Switching:[/b] You can now switch between DirectX 11 and DirectX 12 in the settings. Some players find DX11 provides a more stable experience and better performance, while others find DX12 smoother and better looking. If you're not experiencing crashes and low FPS on DX12, we recommend sticking with it. Otherwise, try DX11. Please note that the default option is DX11, and you’ll need to restart the game after making changes.

[*][b]Weapon Handling: [/b]You can now switch hands with all two-handed weapons using the “X” key.

[*][b]Physics Adjustments:[/b] We've made changes to the physics system, impacting all aspects of gameplay. While this update should make wielding weapons feel better, especially long and heavy ones, it might need some fine-tuning. We welcome your feedback! (We apologize if some things end up more broken than before.)

[*][b]Historical Accuracy:[/b] We've returned some weapons to their historically accurate weight and size thanks to the physics update. Additionally, flags on the playtest map are now historically accurate.

[*][b]Windows now have interiors[/b] :)

[*][b]Factions: [/b]Choosing a tier will randomly assign you to one of four factions. Enemies will belong to one of the other factions, indicated by the coat of arms on shields and clothing colors.

[*][b]Play Card Option:[/b] Before every fight, you now have the "Play Card" option. Choosing the left card will send you into single combat (as before), while choosing the right card will start a group fight.

[*]We’re still working on optimization, with updates planned in the coming weeks. [/list]

That’s it for this update!

[b]Thank you so much for your support. [/b]We’re truly grateful to have you on this journey with us.

Don’t hesitate to leave your feedback on the Steam forum or join our Discord to discuss directly with us! <3

notes.title: Join the first Half Sword Playtests!
notes.content:
Hey Half Sworders, 

Guess what? We've finally wrangled together the latest playtest for you to dive into!

Quick heads-up:[b] This is a playtest, not a demo, so please don't remove the current Abyss demo from Steam.[/b] We're only allowed one demo at a time online, and we want you to keep enjoying the itch and Abyss demos to your heart's content!

About the playtest: We're excited for you to try out the progress we've made on armor, weight mechanics, new weapons, and more. The focus here is on these new systems, so keep your eyes peeled for those details.

WARNING: [b]This is probably the only version without gore we'll ever make[/b], as we needed a “family-friendly” edition for physical events like the Tokyo Game Show in September. So, this closed map is all about testing the new controls, armor, and weapons—nothing else.

[b]Don't worry—violence, blood, and gore are in the works and will be back in future builds.[/b] After the Tokyo Game Show, we'll be sticking to the main version with all the glorious gore and blood VFX you crave. Just be ready to flash your IDs because we'll be age-checking for that exclusive 18+ booth!

[h2]HOW TO JOIN THE PLAYTESTS:[/h2]
[list][*]Go to the Half Sword Steam page
[*]Hit the Join Plyatests Button (you'll need to be logged in)
[*]Please wait for us to accept you (we'll try to do it as many times per week as possible) [/list]

Enjoy the playtest and get ready for more bloody fun soon!

Cheers!
